source.note: 787 Prophet plans ingested; 112 have close-price history for charts.

content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.headline: $OGS turned away at 80 again
queue.body: Until 80 gives way, the ceiling is intact.

$SON reclaim level, 59.5
$SON below that level, base still building
Jobless claims are averaging 198k a week this month, 12.9% below a year ago. Growth is firming while inflation stays warm.

$BRX above 27.4 keeps the base intact
$BRX below 27.4 loses it

$GMAB is pressing the range high.
A failed breakout puts the range back in control.

queue.headline: $PRG hits the same ceiling again
queue.body: Turned away at 34 for the 5th time in the past year. Below 34, the ceiling stays intact.

queue.headline: $AVGO's six-month volume center is overhead
queue.body: 367 is where the most shares changed hands in that window. The stock remains below it.
$AVGO posts its narrowest daily range in 7 sessions after 4 straight down weeks.
$AKAM is sitting inside its six-month range. 86.1 is the floor.

queue.headline: $AMCR just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 85% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 77 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

queue.headline: Cloud Computing ripping, +1.9% avg on Thursday
queue.body: $FSLY +8.7% $CRWD +8.2% $ZS +7.3% $NET +7.3% $PANW +7.2% $FROG +7.2% $S +6.7% $OKTA +5.8% Breadth inside the group, not one leader.
Rep. Sessions' $AAPL filing landed 25 days after the sale. Filing, not a call.
Venrock opened a new $LYCA position with a $631K buy. The filing confirms the trade, but doesn't say what prompted it.

accounts.name: Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.body:
$SHEN closes the week at a 5-year low.
The busiest price from recent trading is now overhead.
The breakdown stands until that price is reclaimed.

$AR setup stays live above its entry.
38.8 is the line.
$RHI is marking up, but 44.8 has to hold.

$WULF has compressed after the recent slide.
11 is the floor. Lose it and the decline isn't over.
Below 28, $BFS loses the range where most six-month volume traded.
Rep. Pete Sessions' $COST sale surfaced 25 days late. A filing, not a call.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.body:
$HMN turned away at 48 again
48 remains the ceiling.
$SFM closed for +5.3%. The next setup has to earn its own entry.

$TREX has to clear 50.1 first.
Then 73.6 is the next test.
Below 34.4, the setup is gone.
After 6 red weeks, $EXK remains below the past six months' most-traded price.
The $OKLO setup failed. 6 red weeks ended at a new yearly closing low.
